citations.claim: initial total energy before any collision
speed increased across the ceiling bounce despite e=1 and no controller, showing energy injection at contact
first energy_bound violation: energy exceeds allowed limit

counterfactual.change: changed only dt from 0.028747307978011009 to 0.001 (same 3 steps, all else identical); fine substeps resolve the ceiling impact without injecting energy

explanation: Single body with e=1 launched upward at ~40.5 m/s from y=11.6 hits the ceiling within step 1 at large dt=0.0287 (40-43 substeps/step). The boundary impulse plus positional correction adds energy instead of preserving it: speed rises from 41.43 to 41.68 across the bounce with controller disabled/work 0, then energy grows each fall step to 1092.7 > 1074.16 limit. Reducing only dt to 0.001 removes the violation, confirming coarse-step contact resolution as the cause.
vision_note: The small blue body starts essentially touching the top boundary in step 0 and then falls progressively lower through steps 1 to 3 while drifting slightly right. There is no visible penetration, escape, or erratic jump – it simply looks like a normal rebound and fall away from the ceiling.
